'''Dee Skaak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Skaak Tippers]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dee Skaak had become a leader of the Skaak Tippers,<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtST" /> a criminal group of [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information brokers]] active on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="CDHZ">[[File:Gal-icon.jpg|14px|link=Sony]] [[CorSec Database H-Z]] on the official ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' website {{C|content now obsolete; [https://web.archive.org/web/20060719111959/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/players/guides.vm?id=80113 backup link]}}</ref> Dee Skaak operated from a [[Skaak Tipper Cave|cave]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtST" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Tomi Skaak]]'s group had stolen a valuable [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact and transferred it to Dee Skaak. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] then sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the [[Skaak Tipper Bunker]] in order to retrieve the Gungan artifact. Several Skaak Tippers, including Tomi Skaak were killed during the assault. The spacer later went to the Skaak Tipper Cave and killed Dee Skaak to finally recover the artifact.<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dee Skaak was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtST" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dee Skaak was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
